title: What Growing Clothing Systems Is
definition: Growing Clothing Systems: clothes grown, not sewn.
description:
Growing Clothing Systems is clothes grown, not sewn. It sits squarely in Future Art, Design & Fashion, the frontier where bio-fabrication science becomes system logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are fit customization-scale. Societies that master system hulls early will shape growth vats practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why bio-fabrication programs worldwide now treat Growing Clothing Systems as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Growing Clothing Systems needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Readiness Estimator: Growing Clothing Systems
definition: Estimates Growing Clothing Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Growing Clothing Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Growing Clothing Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Growing Clothing Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 87896 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where bio-fabrication monitoring, system logistics redundancy, or growth vats maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Growing Clothing Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Growing Clothing Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Growing Clothing Systems — clothes grown, not sewn.

Phase 1 — Prove (bio-fabrication): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (growth vats): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (fit customization): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and fashion-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
